name: CLAUDE_API_KEY
purpose: Claude calls: the job tracker (lead scorer, email classifier, posting reader) and the Python service (rowing photo reader)

name: CLAUDE_MODEL
purpose: Model for every Claude call: lead scoring, email classifier, posting reader (job tracker), rowing photo reader (Python). Blank uses claude-sonnet-5-5. Rough cost per million tokens in/out: Haiku $1/$5, Sonnet $2/$10, Opus $4/$20

name: STEAM_ID
purpose: Steam account the widget reports on (64-bit ID)

name: TFL_APP_KEY
purpose: TfL Unified API, used by the hotel finder

name: SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI
purpose: Must match the URI registered in the Spotify dashboard exactly

name: SPOTIFY_AUTH_STATE
lockedReason: No longer read: the OAuth state is a per-request nonce.

name: EMAIL_BACKEND
purpose: Mail source for the email pipeline

name: EMAIL_SYNC_INTERVAL
purpose: Time between syncs, as a Go duration such as 30m (default 30m)

name: MSGRAPH_REDIRECT_URI
purpose: OAuth callback: https://<domain>/jobs/api/email/callback, registered in Entra

name: IMAP_PASSWORD
purpose: App-specific password, not the account password

name: JOB_LEADS_ENABLED
purpose: Run the periodic job-lead fetch; "Check now" on /jobs/leads works either way

name: JOB_LEADS_INTERVAL
purpose: Time between fetches, as a Go duration such as 6h (default 6h)

name: ADZUNA_APP_ID
purpose: Adzuna job search, for adzuna lead sources

name: ADZUNA_APP_KEY
purpose: Adzuna job search, for adzuna lead sources

name: REED_API_KEY
purpose: Reed job search, for reed lead sources

name: ICECAST_SOURCE_PASSWORD
purpose: Liquidsoap to Icecast, and live broadcasters to the harbor port
warning: Live broadcasting clients must be given the new password.

name: BACKEND_SECRET
purpose: Signs the JWTs in the auth cookies
warning: Rotating this logs everyone out, including you.

name: DOMAIN
purpose: Apex domain: TLS certificate, cookie domain, nginx server name
lockedReason: Changing the domain needs a new certificate and a full restart.

name: EMAIL
lockedReason: Only read by certbot when it registers the account.

name: OBSIDIAN_DIR
purpose: Host path of the notes vault
lockedReason: A bind-mount path: a wrong value stops the stack from starting.

name: SEED_DB
lockedReason: Would inject test data into the live site.

name: BACKEND_HOST
purpose: Backend container name and nginx upstream
lockedReason: Renames a container and repoints nginx.

name: BACKEND_PORT
lockedReason: Renames a container or repoints nginx.

name: BACKEND_ENDPOINT
purpose: URL prefix nginx mounts the API at
lockedReason: The Vue app assumes /api.

name: PYTHON_HOST
purpose: Python container name and nginx upstream
lockedReason: Renames a container and repoints nginx.

name: PYTHON_PORT
lockedReason: Renames a container or repoints nginx.

name: ACTIVITY_TRACKER_IMAGE_TAG
purpose: Activity tracker image tag to run (default latest)

name: USACO_IMAGE_TAG
purpose: USACO site image tag to run (default latest)
lockedReason: Changing it needs a pull: docker compose pull usaco && docker compose up -d usaco.

name: JOBS_IMAGE_TAG
purpose: Job tracker image tag to run (default latest)
lockedReason: Changing it needs a pull: docker compose pull jobs && docker compose up -d jobs.

name: ICECAST_HOST
purpose: Icecast container name and nginx upstream
lockedReason: Renames a container and repoints nginx.

name: ICECAST_PORT
lockedReason: Renames a container or repoints nginx.

name: ICECAST_MOUNT
lockedReason: The player and nginx both assume this mount.

name: LIQUIDSOAP_HARBOR_MOUNT
lockedReason: Broadcasting clients are configured against it.

name: LIQUIDSOAP_HARBOR_PORT
purpose: Live broadcast port, published to the host
lockedReason: A published port: changing it needs the router and clients updated.

name: SILVERBULLET_HOST
lockedReason: Renames a container and repoints nginx.

name: SILVERBULLET_PORT
lockedReason: Renames a container or repoints nginx.

name: SILVERBULLET_PUBLIC_HOST
lockedReason: Renames a container and repoints nginx.

name: SILVERBULLET_PUBLIC_PORT

name: POSTGRES_PORT
lockedReason: Every client of the database assumes it.

name: POSTGRES_DB
lockedReason: Only applied when the volume is first initialised.

name: POSTGRES_TRACKER_DB

name: POSTGRES_TRACKER_PASSWORD

name: USACO_GIT_TOKEN
purpose: Gitea token (repository read and write on adamf/usaco) the site clones and pushes edits with
lockedReason: Made in Gitea (Settings, Applications); rotate it there, then set it here and run docker compose up -d usaco.

name: USACO_WEBHOOK_SECRET
purpose: Shared secret of the usaco repo's Gitea push webhook
lockedReason: Must match the secret on the webhook in Gitea; change both together by hand.

name: TRACKER_TZ
purpose: Timezone where the activity tracker's day starts, e.g. Europe/London (blank is UTC)

name: GITEA_HOST

lockedReason: Renames a container and repoints nginx.

name: GITEA_PORT
lockedReason: Renames a container or repoints nginx.

name: GITEA_INTERNAL_TOKEN
lockedReason: Rotating Gitea's own secrets can invalidate its sessions and LFS links.

name: GITEA_LFS_JWT_SECRET
lockedReason: Rotating Gitea's own secrets can invalidate its sessions and LFS links.

name: GITEA_OAUTH2_JWT_SECRET
lockedReason: Rotating Gitea's own secrets can invalidate its sessions and LFS links.

name: GITEA_RUNNER_NAME
lockedReason: Read by gitea-runner/run.sh on the host, not by a container.
